assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cytosine and adenine base editors turn deaminase chemistry into a programmable, general tool: a defined chemical reaction (C to U or A to I deamination) is directed to a single nucleotide without a double-strand break. The mechanism is clear, the tool is widely used by biologists, and it opens a route to correcting point mutations that underlie many genetic diseases.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu led both the cytosine and adenine base editor programmes; Alexis C. Komor made the first cytosine base editors as a student and Nicole M. Gaudelli the adenine base editor. This supports a clean trio. Credit from the Japanese cytidine-deaminase editing work (Nishida, Kondo) is real but secondary to the Liu lab's general platform; I do not know the precise priority details.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced in many laboratories and organisms, and early clinical programmes exist. Long-term clinical safety and efficacy data are still limited, so recognition could be seen as slightly early, but the chemistry and tool are well established.
uncertainties: Bystander editing and off-target deamination (including RNA and genome-wide) are known limitations whose practical importance I cannot fully judge.
Whether clinical results will be mature enough to satisfy the committee in 2026 is uncertain.
Whether the Japanese deaminase-based work deserves co-recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminator nucleotides, performed on clustered single molecules, is a chemistry and enzymology achievement (nucleotide analogues, polymerase handling, fluorescence detection) that transformed biology and medicine. Its lasting impact is enormous and it is a rare case where nucleotide chemistry is the core enabling step.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman conceived the Solexa approach and founded the company; the reversible-terminator chemistry also has other contributors (for example Jingyue Ju and the Columbia group, and Pascal Mayer's cluster work). A two-person configuration is plausible but the credit split is contested.
assessment.maturity: Technology is commercially dominant for roughly two decades and independently confirmed by countless users; timing is fully mature.
uncertainties: Attribution is genuinely disputed among several groups and companies.
Parts of the invention are engineering rather than discovery, and some members may weigh the chemistry differently.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the chemical solution to the delivery of fragile nucleic acids, based on pH-dependent charge and membrane-fusion behaviour. They underlie siRNA drugs and mRNA vaccines and have had clear, large, demonstrable impact.
assessment.attribution: The Vancouver group (Cullis, Hope, Madden) established the lipid-nanoparticle formulation principles and ionizable lipid concept; MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer contributed to later optimisation and application. The decisive contribution among many is hard to isolate.
assessment.maturity: Thoroughly validated clinically and in the field, though the 2023 Medicine prize for mRNA vaccines may reduce the sense of urgency for Chemistry.
uncertainties: Credit is diffuse across academic and company laboratories, and I cannot verify who made the decisive lipid design steps.
Possible overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Palladium-catalysed C-N coupling made aryl amines accessible under general, predictable conditions, with mechanistic understanding of the catalytic cycle and ligand design. It is used daily in pharmaceutical synthesis and has had enduring impact.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig developed the general catalysts and mechanisms independently; Kosugi's earlier tin-amide work is a precursor but less general. Two laureates is natural.
assessment.maturity: Mature, widely reproduced and industrially central for about three decades; recognition is overdue rather than premature.
uncertainties: Closeness to the 2010 cross-coupling prize may count against it with some members.
Role of Kosugi and Migita as precursors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs allow site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids in living cells, giving biologists a general tool to install new chemistry into proteins. The mechanism is understood and applications are broad.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the original approach; Wang was the key early developer in his laboratory and Chin extended it to multicellular organisms and multiple codons. Mehl and Yokoyama also contributed. Configuration is plausible but not unique.
assessment.maturity: Reproduced extensively and in routine use, with therapeutic proteins in development. Fully mature as a technique.
uncertainties: Several equally credible contributors are left out of any three-person selection.
Impact is mostly as a research tool and I cannot judge how highly other members value it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterobifunctional degraders and molecular glues recruit E3 ligases to destroy target proteins, a new chemical modality that exploits cellular ubiquitin chemistry. Impact on drug discovery is large and clinical trials are underway.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated PROTACs; Ciulli provided the structural basis and VHL ligands. The molecular glue work (Handa, Ito) around thalidomide mechanism is a separate strand, so this is a compound discovery.
assessment.maturity: Mechanism is well supported and independently reproduced, but clinical proof of benefit is still being established; recognition may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: PROTACs and molecular glues may require separate recognition.
No approved PROTAC drug yet to my knowledge.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Phosphoramidite chemistry on solid support made automated, reliable synthesis of oligonucleotides possible, and underpins PCR primers, sequencing, gene synthesis, oligonucleotide therapeutics and genome engineering. It is a fundamental chemical enabling step.
assessment.attribution: Caruthers developed the phosphoramidite method; Leroy Hood is credited for automation instruments, and this contribution is arguably instrumental rather than chemical. A single laureate is defensible but I cannot resolve other contributors from the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Mature for four decades and universally used. Recognition is very late, which is a minor concern for the prize's purposes.
uncertainties: Possible competing prior contributors to nucleotide synthesis chemistry not captured in the credit.
Whether the committee regards it as too old and technical.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat showed that the mutant cysteine of KRAS G12C can be targeted covalently in a specific pocket, overturning the idea that KRAS is undruggable, and developed chemical-genetic analogue-sensitive kinases. It led to approved drugs and a precise chemical concept.
assessment.attribution: Shokat is the sole credited name and clearly the originator of the KRAS G12C covalent strategy; drug development work by companies built on it. A solo prize is feasible though the clinical translation involved others.
assessment.maturity: Approved drugs now confirm it, although durable clinical benefit is limited by resistance. Reasonably mature.
uncertainties: Resistance and modest clinical durability could temper the case.
Chemical genetics of kinases and KRAS are different contributions combined in one entry.
